Source: Across sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), HIV disproportionately affects men who have sex with men (MSM) compared with other men of the same age group in the general population.
Luganda: Okwetooloola Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara (SSA), HIV akosa nnyo abasajja abeegatta ne basajja bannaabwe (MSM) bw’obageraageranya n’abasajja abalala abali mu myaka gyegimu mu bantu bonna okutwaliza awamu.
Yoruba: Ààrùn HIV máa ń ṣe àwọn ọkùnrin tó ń ní ìbálòpọ̀ pẹ̀lú ọkùnrin ̣(MSM) tí a bá wò ó sí iye àwọn ọkùnrin mìíràn tí wọ́n jọ jẹ́gbẹ́ ní apá Gúùsù-Sahara ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Kuyo yonke indawo yezwekazi lase-Afrika eseningizimu ye-Sahara (SSA), i-HIV ihlasela kakhulu amadoda alala namanye amadoda (MSM) uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amadoda aseminyakeni efanayo abaziphilela impilo ejwayelekile.
Hausa: A duk yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara (SSA), cutar HIV tana shafar mazaje da suka yi jima'i da maza (MSM) idan aka kwatanta da sauran mazaje masu shekaru iri ɗaya a cikin jama'a.
Northern Sotho: Go ralala le borwa bja Afrika (SSA), HIV e ama go fetišiša banna bao ba tsenelago thobalano le banna ba bangwe (MSM) ge go bapetšwa le banna ba bangwe ba mengwaga yeo ka setšhabeng ka kakaretšo.
Amharic: ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ሃገሮች (ሰ.በ.አ.ሃ) ኤችአይቪ በመላው ህዝብ ውስጥ ተመሳሳይ የእድሜ ክልል ካላቸው ወንዶች ይልቅ ከወንዶች ጋር ግብረ ስጋ ግንኙነት የሚጽሙ ወንዶችን (ወ.ግ.ወ) ባልተመጣጠነ መልኩ ይጎዳል፡፡

Source: Access to HIV services remains low among this group although several effective interventions have been documented.
Luganda: Okufuna obujjanjabi bwa HIV bukyali wansi mu kibinja ky’abantu kino newankubadde ng’enkola entuukamu ez’enjawulo ez’okuyambako okubulwanyisa ziteekeddwa mu buwandiike.
Yoruba: Ṣíṣe ìtọ́jú HIV jẹ́ nǹkan tí kò wọ́pọ̀ ní àárín àwọn ẹgbẹ́ yìí bí ó tílẹ̀ jẹ́pé àwọn dídásí tí ó dáńgájíá wà ní àkọsílẹ̀.
Zulu: Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ze-HIV kuhlala kuphansi nakuba ukungenelela okuningana okusebenzayo kubhaliwe.
Hausa: Samun dama ga ayyukan HIV ya kasance ƙasa a tsakanin wannan rukunin ko da yake an yi rubuce-rubuce masu tasiri da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Go fihlelela ditirelo tša HIV di tšwela pele go ba fase mo sehlopheng se sa bana le ge e le gore ditsenogare tše mmalwa tše di šomago gabotse di ile tša ngwalwa.
Amharic: በርካታ ውጤታማ እርምጃዎች ቢመዘገቡም በዚህ ቡድን ውስጥ የኤችአይቪ አግልግሎት ተደራሽነት ዝቅተኛ እንደሆነ ነው፡፡

Source: It is therefore important to identify what has worked well to increase the reach of HIV services among MSM.
Luganda: Noolwekyo kya mugaso okuzuula ekyo ekiyambyeko okutumbula empeereza y’obujjanjabi bwa HIV mu MSM.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe pàtàkì láti mọ òun tí wọ́n ṣe dáadáa láti jẹ́ kí ìṣètójú HIV láàárí àwọn MSM gbèrú sí i.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukukhomba ukuthi yini esebenze kahle ukwandisa ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza ze-HIV phakathi kwe-MSM.
Hausa: Don haka, yana da mahimmanci a gano abin da ya yi aiki da kyau wajen ƙara isar da ayyukan HIV a tsakanin MSM.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao go bohlokwa go tseba gore ke eng yeo e šomilego gabotse go oketša phihlelelo ya ditirelo tša HIV gareng ga MSM.

Source: We searched MEDLINE, POPLINE and the Web of Science databases to collect published articles reporting HIV interventions among MSM across sub-Saharan Africa.
Luganda: Twanoonya mu tterekero lya MEDLINE, POPLINE n’erya Web of Science okusobola okukuŋŋaanya ebiwandiiko ebifulumiziddwa nga byoleka enkola z’okuyambako okulwanyisa HIV mu MSM okwetooloola Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara.
Yoruba: A ti wo MEDLINE, POPLINE àti àkójọpọ̀ àwọn dátà sáyẹ́nsì ayélujára láti gba àwọn ìwé àtẹ̀jáde lórí dídásí HIV láàárín àwọn MSM tó wà ní apá Gúúsù Sàhárà ilè Áfríkà.
Zulu: Sacinga MEDLINE, POPLINE kanye ne-Web of Science yesizindalwazi ukuze kuqoqwe izihloko ezishicilelwe ezibika ngokungenelelwa kwe-HIV phakathi kwe-MSM emazweni aseningizimu yeAfrika ye-Sahara.
Hausa: Mun bincika rumbunan adana bayanai na MEDLINE, POPLINE da kuma Web of Science domin tattara maƙalu da aka buga da suke ba da rahoton ayyukan agajin HIV a tsakanin MSM a duk yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara.
Northern Sotho: Re nyakile go bolotatshedimošo bja MEDLINE, POPLINE le bja Web of Science go kgob oketša diatheke tšeo di phatlaladitšwego tšeo di begago ka ga ditsenogare tša HIV gareng ga MSM go ralala le borwa bja Afrika.

Source: The search identified 2627 citations, and following removal of duplicates and inclusion and exclusion criteria, only 15 papers were eligible for inclusion in the review.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko 2627 bye byazuulibwa mu kunoonya, era oluvannyuma lw’okukwakkulamu ebiwandiiko ebyeddiŋŋanye n’okugoberera enkola y’okuteekamu awamu n’okuwandula, ebiwandiiko 15 byokka bye byasigala nga bisaanidde okukozesebwa mu kwekaliriza.
Yoruba: Àwárí yìí ṣe àfihàn ìtọ́kasí 2627, àti títẹ̀lé yíyọ ẹ̀dà-ìwé àti ṣíṣe àfikún àti àyọkúrò òṣùwọ̀n àmúyẹ, ìwé 15 péré ni ó yẹ fún ṣíṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lukhombe izingcaphuno ezi-2627, futhi kulandela ukususwa kwezimpinda kanye nemibandela yokufakwa kanye nokungabandakanyi, amaphepha kuphela ali-15 abefanelekile ukufakwa ekubuyekezweni.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano ƙididdiga guda 2627, kuma bayan cire kwafi da ƙa'idodin haɗawa da keɓancewa, takardu guda 15 ne kawai suka cancanci haɗawa a cikin bitar.
Northern Sotho: Go nyaka fa go hlathile ditsopolwa tše 2627, gomme se se latela go tlošwa ga dinyakwa tša kopišo le tša dikakaretšo le tša go se akaretše, ke fela dipampiri tše 15 tšeo di bilego le maswanedi a go akaretšwa ka tekodišišong.
Amharic: ፍለጋው 2627 ጥቅሶቸን ለይቷል ቅጂዎችን ጭማሪዎችን የማስወጣት፣ የማካተት እና የማግለል መስፈርቶችን በመከተል በግምገማው ለመካተት የበቁት 15 ጽሁፎች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: The articles reported various accrual strategies, namely: respondent-driven sampling, known peers identified through hotspot or baseline surveys, engagement with existing community-based organizations, and through peer educators contacting MSM in virtual sites.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko byalimu enkola z’okweyongera kw’abeetabi ez’enjawulo, omuli: okweroboza okukolebwa ng’abeetabi abafunibwa baleeta bannaabwe bwe bafaanagana, abantu abamanyiddwa okuzuulwa mu bifo mwe bakuŋŋanira oba mu kunoonyereza okw’ekikaabugo okukolebwa ng’okunoonyereza kwennyini okugenda okukolebwa tekunnatandika, okwetaba mu bibiina eby’enjawulo ebiri mu kitundu n’okuyita mu bantu abakola ng’ekyokulabirako eri bannaabwe ne boogeraganya ne MSM mu bifo eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ìwé yìí jábọ̀ oríṣiríṣi ọ̀nà àlékún bí i: àyẹ̀wò aṣàmúlò olùdáhùn, dídá àwọn ẹgbẹ́ yìí mọ̀ nípa wíwo ọ̀gangan ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tàbí àwọn ìwádìí ìpìnlẹ̀, lílo àwọn àjọ àwùjọ tó ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀ ni, àti lílo àwọn olùdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tí wọ́n kàn sí àwọn MSM ní orí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára.
Zulu: Izihloko zabika amasu ahlukahlukene okuqongelela, okungukuthi: isampula elimayelana nomphenduli, ontanga abaziwayo abatholwe nge-hotspot noma nge-baseline surveys, ukusebenzelana nezinhlangano ezizinze emphakathini, ngothisha abangontanga abasebenzisa i-MSM kumasayithi abonakalayo.
Hausa: Maƙalun sun bayar da rahoton dabaru daban-daban na tarawai, waɗanda suka haɗa da: samfurin da aka bayar da amsa, sanannun takwarorinsu da aka gano ta hanyar hotspot ko bincike na asali, haɗin gwiwa tare da ƙungiyoyin tushen al'umma da ake da su, da kuma ta hanyar malamai takwarorinsu suna tuntuɓar MSM a cikin shafukan yanar gizo.
Northern Sotho: Diathekele di begile ka ga maano a mehutahuta a go hwetša, e lego: go dira sampole fao go dirwago ke baarabi, dithaka tše di tsebjago di hlathilwe ka go šomiša mafelo ao a tletšego ka balwetši goba ka dinyakišišo tša motheo, go rerišana le mekgatlo ya setšhabeng, le ka go diriša ba barutiši ba dithaka ka go ikgokaganya le MSM disaeteng tša inthaneteng.
Amharic: ጽሁፎቹ የተለያዩ የማሰባሰብ ስልቶችን ሪፖርት አድርገዋል እነዚህም፤ የምላሽ ሰጪ ተነሳሽነት ናሙና፣ በመገናኛ ነጥብ ወይም በመሰረታዊ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች የሚታወቁ እኩዮች፣ ከነባር ማህበረሰብ-ተኮር ድርጅቶች ጋር ያሉ ግንኙነቶች፣እና ወ.ግ.ወን በምናባዊ ድረ ገጾች በሚያገኙ አቻ አስተማሪዎች ላይ የተመሰረቱ ነበሩ፡፡

Source: Some programs, however, combined some of these accrual strategies.

Source: Peer-led outreach services were indicated to reach and deliver services to more MSM.

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wo bí àwọn ètò lórí HIV tó wà tẹ́lẹ̀ ṣe ti yí ọkàn àwọn MSM tó wà ni apá Gúúsù Sahara ní orílè-èdè Áfíríkà padà láti jẹ́ kí ìmọ̀ nípa HIV tan karírí agbègbè wọ́n.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukubheka ukuthi izinhlelo ze-HIV ezikhona ziyiqinisekisa kanjani i-MSM esendaweni yezwekazi lase-Afrika eseningizimu ye-Sahara ukuthi bacobelele ulwazi lwe-HIV emiphakathini yabo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun so su duba yadda shirye-shiryen cutar HIV na yanzu suka shawo kan MSM a yankin Afirka kudu da Saha don raba bayanan cutar HIV a cikin al'ummominsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go lebelela ka fao mananeo ao a lego gona a HIV a ka huetšago bo MSM ka borwa bja Afrika go abelana tshedimošo ka ga HIV ditšhabeng tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ነባር የኤችአይቪ ፕሮግራሞች ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ሃገሮች ወ.ግ.ወ በማህበረሰባቸው ውስጥ የኤችአይቪ መረጃን እንዲያካፍሉ የሚያደርጉበትን ማሳመኛ ዘዴዎች ለማየት ፈልግው ነበር፡፡

Source: They wanted to see which of these strategies were lacking, and which were best, in reaching, informing and delivering HIV services to MSM.
Luganda: Baayagala okulaba enkola ezaalina obunafu, n’ezaali zisinga mu kutuukirira, okumanyisa awamu n’okutuusa obujjanjabi bwa HIV eri MSM.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ mọ èwo nínú àwọn ọ̀nà yìí ni kò kájúìwọ̀n, àti èyí tí ó dára jù, nínú kíkànsí, mímọ̀ àti jíjíṣé ètò HIV fún àwọn MSM.
Zulu: Bebefuna ukubona ukuthi imaphi kulamasu ebishoda, nokuthi imaphi abencono, ekufinyeleleni, ekwaziseni nase kulethweni kwezinsiza ze-HIV kwi-MSM.
Hausa: Sun so su ga wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan dabarun suka rasa, kuma wanne ne ya fi dacewa, wajen isarwa, sanarwa da isar da ayyuka na cutar HIV ga masu MSM.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go bona ke efe ya mengwa ye yeo e bego e hlaelela, le gore ke efe e lego ye mekaone, go fihleleleng, go tsebiša le go aba ditirelo tša HIV go bo MSM.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ አገልግሎቶችን ወደ ወ.ግ.ወ ለማድረስ፣ ለማሳወቅ እና ለማቅረብ ከእነዚህ ስልቶች ውስጥ የትኛው ጉድለት እንዳለው እና የትኛው እንደሚሻል ለማየት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They gathered all the studies that were related to HIV prevention in MSM in sub-Saharan Africa, from 2007 to 2017.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya okunoonyereza kwonna okwali kukoleddwa nga kwekuusa ku kutangira HIV mu MSM mu Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara, okuva mu 2007 okutuuka mu 2017.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkójọpọ̀ àwọn iṣé ìwádìí tó jọmọ́ dídẹ́kun HIV yìí ní àárín àwọn MSM ní apá Gúúsù Sahara ní Áfíríkà, láti 2007 sí 2017.
Zulu: Bahlanganise zonke izincwaningo ebeziphathelene nokuvikelwa kwe-HIV kwi-MSM yasendaweni yezwekazi lase-Afrika eseningizimu ye-Sahara, kusukela ngowezi-2007 kuya kowezi-2017.
Hausa: Sun tattara duk wani binciken da ya shafi rigakafin cutar HIV a MSM a yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara, daga shekara ta 2007 zuwa 2017.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgoboketša dinyakišišo ka moka tšeo di bego di amana le thibelo ya HIV ka go MSM ka borwa bja Afrika, go thoma ka 2007 go fihla ka 2017.
Amharic: ከ2007 እስከ 2017 ድረስ ከሰሃራ በታች ባሉ የአፍሪካ ወ.ግ.ወ ውስጥ ከኤችአይቪ መከላከል ጋር የተያያዙ ሁሉንም ጥናቶች ሰብስበዋል፡፡

Source: Then, they did a “systematic review” of the studies, which is an established scientific method whereby researchers collect information about a topic from different peer-reviewed articles published on that topic.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma, “beekaliriza” okunonyereza okwo, era ng’eno nkola ya kinassaayansi abanoonyereza mwe bakuŋŋaanyiriza obubaka obukwata ku nsonga emu okuva mu biwandiiko ebyekaliriziddwa abantu ab’enjawulo n’oluvannyuma ne bifulumizibwa ku nsonga eyo.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà ní wọn ṣe “àgbéyẹ̀wò ṣísẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé” lórí àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, èyí tí ó jẹ́ ọ̀nà sáyẹ́nsì tí ó fìdí múlẹ̀ tí àwọn aṣèwádìí ń lò láti gba ìmọ̀ nípa àkọ́lé kan lórí àwọn oríṣiríṣi ìwé àgbéyẹ̀wò-ẹlẹgbẹjẹgbẹ́ tí wọ́n tẹ̀ jáde lórí àwọn àkọ́lẹ́ náà.
Zulu: Base, benza “ukubuyekezwa okuhleliwe” bezincwaningo, okuyindlela yesayensi esunguliwe lapho khona abacwaningi baqoqa khona ulwazi ngesihloko ezisuka ezihlokweni ezahlukene ezibuyekeziwe zontanga ezishicilelwe kuleso sihloko.
Hausa: Sannan, sun yi "bita ta tsari" na binciken, wanda shi ne kafaffen hanyar kimiyya wanda masu bincike suke tattara bayanai game da wani batu daga wasu bugaggun maƙalun da a da aka yi bitarsa a kan wannan batu.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao, ba ile ba dira “tekodišišo ya tshepedišo” ya dinyakišišo, e lego mojgwa wa tša mahlale wo o hlomilwego fao banyakišiši ba kgoboketšago tshedimošo ka ga hlogotaba go tšwa go diathekele tšeo di lekodišišitšwego ke ditsebi tšeo di phatlaladitšwego ka ga hlogotaba ye.
Amharic: ከዚያም የጥናቶቹን “ስልታዊ ግምገማ” አከናውነዋል፤ ይህም ተመራማሪዎች በርእሱ ላይ የተጻፉ ከተለያዩ በአቻ ከተገመገሙ ህትመቶች መረጃዎችን የሚሰበስቡበት ተቀባይነት ያለው ሳይንሳዊ ዘዴ ነው፡፡

Source: The researchers found 2627 studies on the topic, but only 15 of those met their criteria for reviewing.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baafuna okunoonyereza kwa mirundi 2627 ku nsonga eno, naye nga mu ebyo byonna, 15 byokka bya byatuukiriza ebisaanyizo by’okwekalirizibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí rí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí 2627 lórí àkọlé, ṣùgbọ́n 15 péré ni ó kújúìwọ̀n fún àgbéyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole izincwaningo eziyi-2627 kulesi sihloko, kodwa kuphela eziyi-15 zalezo ezaziphumelela kwimibandela yazo yokubuyekezwa.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sami bincike guda 2627 a kan batun, amma guda 15 ne kawai daga ciki waɗanda suka cika ka'idojinsu don yin bita.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše dinyakišišo tše 2627 ka ga hlogo taba ye, eupša ke fela tše 15 tša tšona tše di fihleletšego dinyakwa tša tekodišišo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በዚህ ርእስ ላይ 2627 ጥናቶችን አግኝተዋል ነገር ግን ከእነዚያ ውስጥ 15ቱ ብቻ የግምገማ መስፈርታቸውን አሟልተዋል፡፡

Source: These 15 papers described a few ways to reach MSM, including “respondent-driven sampling”, which means getting MSM to recruit more MSM.
Luganda: Ebiwandiiko bino 15 byannyonnyola enkola entonotono ezisobola okukozesebwa okutuukirira MSM, omuli “okweroboza okukolebwa ng’abeetabi abafunibwa baleeta bannaabwe bwe bafaanagana”, ekitegeza okufuna MSM ne bafuna MSM abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwé 15 yìí ṣe àpèjúwe àwọn ọ̀nà à ti bá MSM, “pẹ̀lú àyẹ̀wò ìṣàmúlò olùdáhùn” Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé kí àwọn MSM gbá MSM tuntun sí i.
Zulu: Lamaphepha ali-15 achaza izindlela ezimbalwa zokufinyelela kwi-MSM, kufaka phakathi “isampula elibhekele umphenduli” okuchaza ukuthola i-MSM ukuze izobutha i-MSM eningi.
Hausa: Waɗannan takaddun guda 15 sun bayyana ‘yan hanyoyi don isa ga MSM, gami da "samfur ta hanyar-sanayya", wanda yake nufin samun MSM don ɗaukar ƙarin MSM.
Northern Sotho: Dipampiri tše 15 tše di be di hlaloša mekgwa ye mmalwa ya go fihlelela bo MSM, go akaretšwa “sampole ya go dirwa ke baarabi”, go rago go kgopela bo MSM go hlohleletša bo MSM ba bangwe.
Amharic: እነዚህ 15 ጽሁፎች ወ.ግ.ወን ለመድረስ የ“ምላሽ ሰጪ” ተነሳሽነት ናሙናን ጨምሮ ማለትም ወ.ግ.ወ ሌሎች ተጨማሪ ወ.ግ.ወን እንዲመለምሉ ጥቂት መንገዶችን ገልጸዋል፡፡

Source: In this regard, researchers also noted that community-based organisations use MSM outreach workers to find more MSM, and social media or MSM hotspots may be useful.
Luganda: Mu ngeri eno, abanoonyereza era baazuula ng’ebibiina by’omu bitundu bikozesa abakozi abakunga MSM okusobola okufuna MSM abalala, n’emikutu emigattabantu oba ebifo omukuŋŋanirwa MSM biyinza okuba eby’omugaso.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àkíyèsí pé àwọn àjọ àwùjọ máa ń lo àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjáde MSM láti wá àwọn MSM mìíràn sí i, àti wí pé ìkànnì ayélujára tàbí ààyè àwọn MSM lè wúlò.
Zulu: Mayelana nalokhu, abacwaningi baqaphelile ukuthi izinhlangano ezigxile emphakathini zisebenzisa abasebenzi abaphumela emphakathini be-MSM ukuze bathole i-MSM eningi, futhi izinkundla zokuxhumana noma i-MSM hotspot zingasetshenziswa.
Hausa: Dangane da wannan, masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa ƙungiyoyin jama'a suna amfani da ma'aikatan wayar da kan MSM don samun ƙarin MSM, kuma kafofin watsa labarun ko wuraren da MSM suke na iya zama da amfani.
Northern Sotho: Mabapi le se, banyakišiši le bona ba lemogile gore mekgatlo ya setšhabeng e šomiša bašomi ba go ya go bo MSM go hwetša bo MSM ba bangwe, gomme mafelo a go tlala ka kgašo ya setšhaba goba ka MSM a ka ba mohola.
Amharic: በዚህ ረገድ ተመራማሪዎች በማህበረሰብ ላይ የተመሰረቱ ድርጅቶች ተጨማሪ ወ.ግ.ወን ለማግኘት የወ.ግ.ወን የእርዳታ ሰራተኞች እንደሚጠቀሙ እና የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ወይም የወ.ግ.ወ መገናኛ ነጥቦች ጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል፡፡

Source: But finding these hotspots may be difficult, and not all MSM use social media.
Luganda: Naye okufuna ebifo bino kiyinza okuba ekizibu, ate era nga si kugamba nti MSM bonna bakozesa emikutu emigattabantu.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n rírí àwon ààyè yìí lè ṣòro díẹ̀, àti wí pé kì í ṣe gbogbo wọn ní máa lo ìkònì ayélujára.
Zulu: Kodwa ukuthola lama-hotspot kungaba nzima, futhi hayi ukuthi onke ama-MSM asebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana.
Hausa: Amma gano waɗannan wuraren na iya zama da wahala, kuma ba duka MSM suke amfani da kafofin watsa labarun ba.
Northern Sotho: Eupša go hwetša mafelo a a go tlala go ka ba boima, ebile ga se bo MSM ka moka bao ba šomišago kgašo ya setšhaba.
Amharic: ግን እነዚህን መገናኛ ነጥቦች ማግኘት ይቸግር ይሆናል፤ እንዲሁም ሁሉም ወ.ግ.ወ ማህበራዊ ሚዲያን አይጠቀሙም፡፡

Source: Popular ways to deliver HIV information included virtual, community-based and facility-based (at healthcare sites).
Luganda: Enkola enjatiikirivu ez’okutuusa obubaka obukwata ku HIV mwalimu okuwuliziganya nabo nga tewali n’omu alaba ku munne n’okububatuusizaako mu bifo ewajjanjabirwa (mu malwaliro).
Yoruba: Ọ̀nà tí ó gbajúgbajà láti jíṣẹ́ ìmọ̀ HIV ni lílo ayélujára, àwùjọ, àti àwọn ohun èlò (ní ilé ìwòsàn).
Zulu: Izindlela ezidumile zokuletha ulwazi lwe-HIV kubalwe okubonakalayo, okugxile emphakathini, nokugxile ezikhungweni (emagcekeni emitholampilo).
Hausa: Shahararrun hanyoyin isar da bayanan cutar HIV sun haɗa a aikace, tushen al'umma da tushen kayan aiki (a wuraren kiwon lafiya).
Northern Sotho: Ditsela tše di tumilego tša go aba tshedimošo ka ga HIV a akareditše a inthaneteng, a setšhabeng le a mafelong (ka mafelong a tlhokomelo ya maphelo).
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ መረጃን ለማድረስ ታዋቂ መንገዶች ምናባዊ፣ ማህበረሰብ-ተኮር እና በመገልገያ (በጤና አጠባበቅ ጣቢያዎች) ላይ የተመሰረቱትን ያካትታሉ፡፡

Source: They found that “peer-led outreach”, which is communication and recruitment through friends, was the most successful because MSM felt more comfortable.
Luganda: Baazuula nti “okukunga okukulembeddwamu abeekinywi”, okukolebwa ng’okuwuliziganya n’okufuna abantu abalala bitambulira mu bantu ab’ekinywi, kwe kwali kusinga okukola obulungi kubanga kwali kuwa MSM eddembe n’obutebenkevu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí wí pé “jíjáde àwọn olórí tí wọ́n yàn” èyí tí ó jẹ́ bíbáni sọ̀rọ̀ àti gbígba àwọn èèyàn tuntun láti ara àwọn ọ̀rẹ́, jẹ́ èyí tí ó yege jù lọ nítorí àwọn MSM faramọ́ èyí dáadáa.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi “umsebenzi wokuphumela emphakathini oholwa ontanga”, okuwukuxhumana nokubutha kusetshenziswa abangani, iyona eyayiphumelela kakhulu ngoba i-MSM yazizwa ikhululeke kahle.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa "isa ta hanyar abota", wanda shi ne sadarwa da ɗaukar ma'aikata ta hanyar abokai, shi ne mafi nasara saboda mai MSM ya fi jin daɗi.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore “go ya go bona fao go etilwego ke dithaka”, e lego ka dikgokagano le go hlohleletša ka bagwera, go bile seo se atlegilego kudu ka gobane bo MSM ba ile ba ikw aba lokologile kudu.
Amharic: “አቻ-መር እርዳታ” ማለትም በጓደኛሞች በኩል የሚደረግ ተግባቦት እና ምልመላ፣ ለወ.ግ.ወ የበለጠ ምቾት ስለሚሰጣቸው በጣም ስኬታማ እንደሆነ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

Source: The researchers said their conclusions must be interpreted with caution because they don’t know if their listed approaches work well, and they didn’t include non-English studies.
Luganda: Abanonyereza baagamba nti okuwunzika kwabwe kuteekeddwa okutaputibwa n’obwegendereza kubanga tebamanyi oba ng’enkola ze baamenya zikola bulungi, ate era tebaakozesa kunoonyereza kwali kuwandiikiddwa mu lulimi olutali Lungereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ní kí àwọn èèyàn ṣọ́ra pẹ̀lú bí wọ́n ṣe máa tú àgbálọgbábọ̀ wọ́n nítorí pé wọ́n kàn mọ̀ bóyá àwọn ọ̀nà tí wọ́n ṣe àtòjọ rẹ̀ máa ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni wọn kò fí ìwádìí tí kìí ṣe ti Gẹ̀ẹ́sì kún un.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathena isiphetho sabo kumele sitolikwe ngesinono ngoba abazi ukuthi izindlela abazibalile zisebenza kahle yini, futhi akaze bezifake izincwaningo okungazona ezesilungu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce dole ne a fassara sakamakonsu da taka tsantsan saboda ba su san ko hanyoyin da aka lissafa suna aiki da kyau ba, kuma ba su haɗa da bincike da ba na Ingilishi ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bona ba boletše gore dipheto tša bona di swanetše go hlathollwa ka tlhokomelo ka gobane ge eba mekgwa ya bona ye e ngwadilwego e šoma gabotse, gomme ga se ba akaretša dinyakišišo tše e sego tša Seisemane.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የተዘረዘሩት አካሄዶቻቸው በተገቢ መልኩ እንደሚሰሩ አያውቁም እንዲሁም በእንግሊዘኛ ያልሆኑ ጥናቶችን ባለማካተታቸው ምክንያት ድምዳሜዎቻቸው በጥንቃቄ መተርጎም አንዳለባቸው ያሳስባሉ፡፡

Source: They suggested that more HIV information and services should be available to MSM at healthcare sites, and that the stigma around MSM communities should be reduced so that they feel more comfortable to seek medical care.
Luganda: Baateesa nti obubaka n’obujjanjabi bungi obukwata ku HIV busaanye bubeere nga butuuka ku MSM mu malwaliro, ate era n’okuboola MSM mu bitundu kusaanye kukendeezebwe basobole okufuna embavu ezinoonya obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dábàá pé bí ìmọ̀ àti ètò nípa bí HIV ṣe ń wà fún àwọn MSM ní àwọn ilé-ìtọ́jú, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni kí ìdẹ́yẹsí ní sàkánì àwọn MSM dínkù kí ó lè rọrùn fún wọn láti wa ìtọ́jú sí ìlera wọn.
Zulu: Babeke ukuthi ulwazi oluningi nge-HIV nezinsiza kumele ikuthole i-MSM emagcekeni emitholampilo, nokucwasa emiphakathini ye-MSM kumele kwehliswe ukuze bezozizwa bekhululekile ukuyobheka ukunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Hausa: Sun ba da shawarar cewa ya kamata a sami ƙarin bayanai da ayyuka HIV ga MSM a wuraren kiwon lafiya, kuma ya kamata a rage ƙyama da take tsakanin al'ummomin MSM don su sami kwanciyar hankali don neman magani.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gore tshedimošo le ditirelo tše ntši ka ga HIV e swanetše go hwetšagala go bo MSM ka mafelong a tlhokomelo ya maphelo, le gore bogoboga mabapi le ditšhaba tša MSM bo swanetše go fokotšwa gore ba ikwe ba lokologile kudu go nyaka tlhokomelo ya kalafo.
Amharic: ተጨማሪ የኤችአይቪ መረጃ እና አገልግሎቶች በጤና አጠባበቅ ጣቢያዎች ለወ.ግ.ወ መገኘት እንዳለባቸው እና በተመቻቸ ስሜት ህክምና ማግኘት እንዲፈልጉ በወ.ግ.ወ ማህበረሰቦች ዙሪያ ያለው መገለል መቀነስ እንዳለበት ጠቁመዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers hoped that by knowing how to effectively educate MSM about HIV prevention and treatment, services for this community in sub-Saharan Africa will improve.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasuubira nti okuyita mu kumanya okusomesa obulungi MSM ku ngeri y’okwewala n’okujjanjaba HIV, obujjanjabi eri abantu bano abali mu Afirika esangibwa mu ddungu Sahara bujja kulongooka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ní ìrètí pé mímọ ọ̀nà à ti ṣe ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ tóyèpooro fún awọn MSM nípa ìdènà àti ìtọ́jú HIV, iṣẹ́ fún àdúgbò yìí nínú apá Gúúsù Sahara ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà máa dára sí i.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathembile ukuthi ngokwazi ukuthi ufundisa kanjani ngempumelelo i-MSM ngokuvikela i-HIV nokwelashwa, izinsiza zalo mphakathi osezindaweni zezwekazi lase-Afrika oseningizimu ye-Sahara zizokhula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi fatan cewa ta hanyar sanin yadda za a ilimantar da masu MSM yadda ya kamata game da rigakafin cutar HIV da jiyya, ayyuka na wannan al'umma a yankin Afirka kudu da Sahara zai inganta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba holofela gore ge ba ka tseba gore ba ka ruta gabotse bjang bo MSM ka ga thibelo le kalafo ya HIV, ditirelo tša go ya ditšhabeng tše ka borwa bja Afrika di ka kaonafala.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ወ.ግ.ወን ስለ ኤችአይቪ መከላከል እና ህክምና ውጤታማ በሆነ መንገድ እንዴት ማስተማር እንደሚቻል በማወቅ በአፍሪካ ከሰሃራ በታች ያለውን የዚህን ማህበረሰብ አገልግሎት ማሻሻል ይቻላል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ፡፡
